description: Takes a commitmentId. Validates the id format, looks up the Trade Manifest in the commitment store, and returns it. Returns a not-found response if the commitment does not exist. Read-only: never triggers settlement. Note: the MCP instance keeps its own in-process commitment store (issued commitments from this instance).

commitmentId.description: The commitment id (0x-prefixed or agent-id style) to look up

name: get_commitment
title: Get a commitment manifest
